items.quote: How to actually create a pipeline? If you're only hunting for sellers who are ready to sell now, you'll always keep hunting. To build a sustainable pipeline, focus on nurturing relationships with potential sellers over time.
items.statement: Focus on nurturing relationships with potential sellers over time.

items.quote: Think about what value you can provide to property owners to be the first one to find out that they are selling...
items.statement: Value provided to property owners can lead to preferred seller relationships.
